object.name: evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
object.digest: Coefficients calculator for polyphase IIR halfband allpass quadrature hilbert filter cascade, outputs messages, dict and buffer~ arrays
object.description: evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs wraps js code that implements the Laurent de Soras HIIR library. Using this library we can calculate filter coefficients for high quality polyphase IIR halfband allpass cascades. In evieve the filter cascades are realised in standard evieve GenExpr code (<o>evi.hilbert~</o> and <o>evi.freqshift.hilbert~</o>).

outlets.digest: coefficients in format set by the @iterate attribute.
outlets.description: If @iterate = 0, the word 'coeffs' followed by a list of coefficients. If @iterate = 1 (default), the word 'coeffN' repeatedly, where 'N' is the coefficient number, followed by a single coefficient.

outlets.digest: individual coefficients or dictionary data depending on 'peek' and 'dict' messages to the object
outlets.description: Receive query reults from internal [buffer~] and [dict].

arguments.name: Data name
arguments.description: The name of the internal data structures (buffer~ and dict). By default this is a unique name. Give your own name here if you want to access the data in other data objects in your patcher. Either way you can still query all internal data and utilise the dumpout outlet.

arguments.name: Number of coefficients
arguments.description: Set the number of coefficients to create, 2..64, default 8 (for evieve Hilbert). Does not technically recompute coefficients, but coefficients are computed on load or via a bang to the inlet.

arguments.name: Transition bandwidth
arguments.description: Set the filter transition bandwidth to use in Hz, default 40, 4..samplerate*0.25. Does not technically recompute coefficients, but coefficients are computed on load or via a bang to the inlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: In left inlet, bang message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs

messages.name: int
messages.digest: In left inlet, int message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
messages.description: (int) Set the number of coefficients to create, 2..64, default 8 (for evieve Hilbert). Does not recompute coefficients.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: In left inlet, float message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
messages.description: (float) Set the filter transition bandwidth to use in Hz, default 40, 4..samplerate*0.25. Does not recompute coefficients.

messages.name: sr
messages.digest: In left inlet, sr message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
messages.description: The word 'sr' will (re)grab the current samplerate and recalculate and output the coefficients.

messages.name: buffer
messages.digest: In left inlet, buffer message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
messages.description: The word 'buffer' followed by a 'write' message: write, writeaiff, writeflac, writeraw, writewave, will write the contents of the internal coefficients [buffer~] to a file.

messages.name: peek
messages.digest: In left inlet, peek message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
messages.description: The word 'peek' followed by an integer representing an index of the internal [buffer~] will output the corresponding coefficient as a float from the far right dumpout outlet.

messages.name: dict
messages.digest: In left inlet, dict message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
messages.description: The word 'dict' followed by a message that [dict] understands (excluding clear, import, read, readagain, readany) will send the message to the internal [dict] object. Query results are available at the far right dumpout outlet.

messages.name: view
messages.digest: In left inlet, view message to evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs
messages.description: The word 'view' will open the editing windows of the internal [dict] and [buffer~] objects to view their contents.

attributes.name: iterate
attributes.description: 0 = output coefficients as list (Max), 1 = output coefficients iteratively one by one (gen~)
